recommendedFirstCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"

candidateForecastContracts.title: Threshold event risk
candidateForecastContracts.questionTemplate: Will the named future operating window exceed the declared threshold before the resolution deadline?
candidateForecastContracts.decisionToSupport: Prioritize, warn, defer, or allocate capacity based on a measurable future event.
candidateForecastContracts.horizon: future window supplied by the host app
candidateForecastContracts.resolutionRule: Resolve from an approved outcome source after the close time using the declared threshold.

baselineMethod.notes: Start with a baseline until resolved outcomes justify stronger methods.

candidateForecastContracts.nextAction: Collect approved source references and run source intake before any forecast execution.

candidateForecastContracts.title: Ambiguous threshold forecast
candidateForecastContracts.questionTemplate: Will the future event be bad enough to change the host decision?
candidateForecastContracts.decisionToSupport: Support a host action only after the caller defines what bad enough means.
candidateForecastContracts.horizon: future window is present but threshold is missing
candidateForecastContracts.resolutionRule: Resolution cannot be scored until the measurable threshold is supplied.

baselineMethod.notes: Start with a baseline until resolved outcomes justify stronger methods.

candidateForecastContracts.nextAction: Ask for a numeric threshold, categorical threshold, or explicit yes/no outcome rule.

candidateForecastContracts.title: Unsafe private source setup
candidateForecastContracts.questionTemplate: Will records from a private source predict a future host outcome?
candidateForecastContracts.decisionToSupport: Stop setup until private inputs are replaced with approved references.
candidateForecastContracts.horizon: future window cannot be evaluated from unsafe inputs
candidateForecastContracts.resolutionRule: Blocked inputs cannot enter source intake or resolution setup.

baselineMethod.notes: Start with a baseline until resolved outcomes justify stronger methods.

candidateForecastContracts.nextAction: Replace raw payloads with source references, credential references, and caller approval records.

candidateForecastContracts.title: Past outcome analysis
candidateForecastContracts.decisionToSupport: Historical analysis may be useful, but it is not a future forecast contract.
candidateForecastContracts.resolutionRule: Past-tense questions are not forecastable by the setup-engine path.

baselineMethod.notes: Start with a baseline until resolved outcomes justify stronger methods.

candidateForecastContracts.nextAction: Rewrite the request as a future-facing measurable question or use a non-forecast analysis path.

requiredSourceRoles.purpose: Evidence known before close time that can support a forecast.
requiredSourceRoles.nextAction: Bind approved forecast-time evidence through source intake or adapter output.

requiredSourceRoles.purpose: Past comparable outcomes used for the baseline and benchmark gate.
requiredSourceRoles.nextAction: Provide comparable historical examples before selecting stronger methods.

requiredSourceRoles.purpose: Outcome evidence collected after close time to resolve and score forecasts.
requiredSourceRoles.nextAction: Declare the resolver source and scoring rule before creating forecasts.

requiredSourceRoles.purpose: Policy metadata that records approval, retention, tenant scope, and blocked source kinds.
requiredSourceRoles.nextAction: Record source policy before source intake, forecast execution, or resolution.

baselineGuidance.notes: The setup-engine path ranks contracts and source roles; it does not claim model lift before scored outcomes exist.

hostWrapper.recommendedDataShape: Render this setup-engine JSON directly as the host prediction setup plan before forecast cards exist.
hostWrapper.nextAction: Choose one forecastable contract, bind approved sources, then use source intake and method gates.

claimBoundary.notes: Setup-engine output is a planning and contract readback; quality claims require resolved comparable outcomes.

exampleGoals.goal: Predict whether a delivery lane will exceed a late-arrival threshold during a future dispatch window.
Predict whether a product will stock out before the next replenishment window.
Predict whether an operational queue will breach a declared SLA threshold during a future service window.
Predict whether future demand will be risky next month.
Use this API token and raw customer table to predict which accounts will churn next quarter.
Predict whether a berth will be unavailable during a future vessel arrival window.
Explain whether yesterday's weather caused the operations disruption.
Predict whether a public transit service window will exceed a delay or disruption threshold in the future.

interfaceBindings.command: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"
interfaceBindings.boundary: CLI returns a checked setup plan and does not create forecast artifacts.
Agent-call wraps the same setup plan in one transport-neutral envelope.
MCP exposes goal and view arguments only; it rejects hidden raw payload fields.

followUpSurfaces.command: python3 scripts/ope.py explain-fit --goal "add predictions to my app"
followUpSurfaces.relationship: Use for a short fit verdict after reading setup-engine summary.
Use for machine-readable helps-with and does-not-provide boundaries.
Use after choosing to wire OPE into a host project.
Use when a host feature needs compact accepted/blocked response examples.
Use only after approved source references or caller-approved local files exist.

warnings: Setup-engine is the preferred first readback for agents adding prediction to a host project.
It returns contracts, source roles, baseline guidance, host-wrapper shape, and claim boundaries before forecast artifacts exist.
It does not execute source reads, store credentials, accept raw private rows, create hosted runtime, or claim model quality.
